description: Preserve deployed MySQL alongside planned Postgres and infer PHP from explicit framework facts.

messages.content: As of 2026-09-14T10:00:00Z the project Atlas uses Laravel in production. Laravel is implemented in PHP. Atlas uses MySQL as its production-primary database. We plan to replace that role with PostgreSQL, also called Postgres; PostgreSQL is not yet deployed.

dream.instructions: Produce at least one conservative useful insight from the current facts. Explain the current stack and that a planned migration is not production evidence; cite only current fact IDs for actual stack claims. Do not present PostgreSQL as deployed.
